entries.value: "The `bsc ui` CLI — the ONE UI-design-surface command (#2469): the spec-first SDK's KitNode contract (embedded from src-tauri/data/ui/kit-nodes.json, the ONE source of truth shared with the frontend SDK) + structural validator + theme registry (#1852), with the component-library store verbs (list/get/set/remove · kit · eslint-preset · usage, #2281) mounted from bsc-component."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# Tauri-free, SQLite-free: a tiny CLI over an embedded JSON contract. The hyphenated package name maps

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# `bsc ui emit records` is the agent-facing door onto the record emitter; the lean `bsc-emit`
# binary is the build tree's. Same library, so the two cannot describe the same run differently.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): CmdDoc help catalog + help dispatch.
# Base-dir resolution for the default released-kit store root (~/.base-studio-code/kits, #2465).
# The component-library store CLI (#2281), mounted under `bsc ui` (#2469): list/get/set/remove +
# kit/eslint-preset/usage delegate to bsc_component::cli; its CmdDocs compose into the merged help.
# The verbatim-JSON-per-id store (#2158) backing the designer-writable THEME collection (#2488):
# `bsc ui theme set/remove` persist to ~/.base-studio-code/themes/<id>.json.
# Named directly (not just via bsc-component) because `record_source` is re-exported from here.
# preserve_order: the packaged algorithms.json is REWRITTEN by `refresh-seed`, and a BTreeMap would
# re-sort every key in a 6.6 MB file — a one-record change arriving as a 22,500-line diff.
# Tree-sitter TSX parsing for `bsc ui harvest` (#3471) — the component half of `bsc graph harvest`.
# Same pinned versions bsc-graph already locks, so this adds no new workspace dependency.
# Content hashing for the kit store's id@version integrity (#2465). Same version the app crate
# already locks, so this adds no new dependency to the workspace graph.
# The import-rewrite cluster ported from `scripts/lib/recordSource.mjs` — three multiline patterns
# whose JS semantics are a translation rather than a re-derivation. Already in the workspace lock via
# `bsc-agent` and `llm`, so it costs no new compile.
# `bsc ui census` reads BOTH record stores — the components here and the algorithm impls there —
# because a record can claim a module from either. bsc-graph takes bsc-data with default-features off,
# so this does NOT drag the DuckDB amalgamation back into `cargo check -p bsc-ui` (2m28s vs 20.8s,
# measured — see bsc-graph's own Cargo.toml for why that dependency is pinned off).
